title: Painted Key
summary: Opens the Painted Chest in a room north of Aelis’s sewer lair.

fields.Acquisition: DC 20 Perception reveals the loose stone at X −131, Y 880 hiding the key.
fields.Alternative: DC 20 Sleight of Hand opens the chest without it.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
